data.content_ref: inline:The diagnostic overlay program (SRC_003, SRC_012, SRC_005) abstracts to the principle that every grounded-extension outcome has a local, deterministic, polynomial explanation. This abstraction is refuted if there exists an undecided node whose suspension reason is genuinely global — e.g., a node suspended only because of a cycle of mutual attacks of length O(V) where no bounded local neighborhood determines the suspension. The bounded BFS in SRC_005 would misclassify such a node as 'standing' when it is actually part of a large-scale structure that a different decomposition would explain.
